name: my-fn
description: A function-wasm ABI v2 guest in TypeScript, componentized with jco; fetch() rides wasi:http through the host's egress policy

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:log --outfile=dist/bundle.js && jco componentize dist/bundle.js --wit wit -n function -o fn.wasm
